verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents a dedicated streaming capability that sends responses back in chunks and displays them incrementally as the model generates them, and its OpenAI-compatible API means standard streaming clients should work. The node SDK's TCP warming and payload compression are also documented as ways to cut time-to-first-token. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the SSE wire format and per-token chunk semantics, and independent or hands-on confirmation that streaming works.
